all_formulas.decision: No-till reduces fuel 60-70%. GPS auto-steer reduces overlap 5-10%. Both cut CO₂ + save $.
all_formulas.notes: EPA emission factors 2023. Include upstream (refining) for full LCA: ×1.2 for diesel.
all_formulas.purpose_ar: حساب البصمة الكربونية للوقود الزراعي.
all_formulas.variables_ar: L_diesel = لتر الديزل

all_formulas.name: Cover Crop C Sequestration
all_formulas.variables:
biomass = above-ground DM (t/ha)
%C = 40% of DM
root_shoot = 0.3 (roots = 30% of shoot)
stabilization = 0.15 (15% becomes stable SOC)
t = years
all_formulas.purpose: Estimate SOC sequestration from cover crops. Ranges 0.5-3 t CO₂e/ha/yr depending on biomass + climate.
all_formulas.example: Rye cover crop 5 t DM/ha: ΔC = 5 × 0.4 × 1.3 × 0.15 = 0.39 t C/ha/yr = 1.43 t CO₂e/ha/yr. At $15/t = $21/ha carbon revenue.
all_formulas.pitfall: Sequestration rate declines over time (saturation at 10-20 yr). Not permanent — stops if practice stops.
all_formulas.decision: Mix grasses (rye, oats) + legumes (vetch, clover) for max biomass + N. Terminate 2-3 weeks before cash crop.
all_formulas.notes: FAO 2019. Soil Health Institute meta-analysis: 0.5-1.5 t CO₂e/ha/yr average. Tropical: 1.5-3 t.
all_formulas.purpose_ar: تقدير عزل الكربون العضوي من محاصيل التغطية.
all_formulas.variables_ar:
biomass = الكتلة الحيوية
%C = نسبة الكربون
root_shoot = الجذر/الساق

all_formulas.name: RUSLE (Universal Soil Loss Equation)
all_formulas.formula: A = R × K × LS × C × P
all_formulas.variables:
A = annual soil loss (t/ha/yr)
R = rainfall erosivity (MJ·mm/ha/hr/yr)
K = soil erodibility (t·ha·hr/ha/MJ/mm)
LS = slope length × steepness
C = cover management factor (0–1)
P = support practice factor (0–1)
all_formulas.purpose: Predict long-term average soil erosion from water. Standard for USDA-NRCS conservation planning. Tolerance level (T) = 5-11 t/ha/yr depending on soil.
all_formulas.example: Iowa field: R=140, K=0.03, LS=1.5 (6% slope, 60m), C=0.2 (corn residue), P=0.5 (contour). A = 140×0.03×1.5×0.2×0.5 = 0.63 t/ha/yr. Below T=5 — sustainable.
all_formulas.pitfall: RUSLE is annual average. Single storms can cause >50% of annual erosion. RUSLE2 adds storm-level detail.
all_formulas.decision: If A > T: reduce C (cover crops, no-till), reduce P (terraces, contour), or reduce LS (strip cropping).
all_formulas.notes: Renard et al. (1997). R factor from isoerodent maps. K from soil survey. LS from slope length + steepness tables.
all_formulas.purpose_ar: التنبؤ بمتوسط الفقد طويل المدى للتربة من الماء.
all_formulas.variables_ar:
R = تآكل المطر
K = قابلية التربة
LS = الطول × الانحدار
C = الغطاء
P = الممارسات

all_formulas.name: Wind Erosion Equation (WEQ)
all_formulas.formula: E = I × K × C × L × V
all_formulas.variables:
E = annual soil loss (t/ha/yr)
I = soil erodibility (t/ha)
K = surface roughness
C = climate factor (wind + temp)
L = field length (unsheltered)
V = vegetative cover
all_formulas.purpose: Predict wind erosion — dominant in arid/semi-arid regions. Critical for North Africa, Middle East, Central Asia where >50% of farmland is wind-eroded.
all_formulas.example: Sandy loam, bare fallow, 400m field: I=220, K=0.6, C=0.9, L=0.8, V=0.05. E = 220×0.6×0.9×0.8×0.05 = 4.75 t/ha/yr. Add cover crop: V=0.5 → E = 1.9.
all_formulas.pitfall: WEQ is empirical, 1960s data. Modern WEPS (Wind Erosion Prediction System) is process-based + more accurate.
all_formulas.decision: Reduce E: increase V (cover crop/stubble), reduce L (shelterbelts), increase K (rough surface).
all_formulas.notes: Woodruff + Siddoway (1965). WEPS (USDA-ARS) is replacement, available as online tool.
all_formulas.purpose_ar: التنبؤ بالتعرية بالرياح — مهيمن في المناطق القاحلة وشبه القاحلة.
all_formulas.variables_ar:
E = الفقد
I = قابلية التربة
K = خشونة السطح
C = المناخ
L = طول الحقل
V = الغطاء النباتي

all_formulas.name: Sediment Delivery Ratio (SDR)
all_formulas.variables:
A = watershed area (km²)
SDR = fraction of eroded soil reaching stream
all_formulas.purpose: Estimate how much eroded soil actually reaches waterways. Most deposited before stream. Critical for water quality modeling.
all_formulas.pitfall: SDR varies by watershed shape + drainage density. Use local calibration if available.
all_formulas.decision: Buffer strips trap sediment. 10 m buffer removes 70-90% sediment before stream.
all_formulas.notes: Roehl (1962). SDR decreases with watershed size — more deposition in larger basins.
all_formulas.purpose_ar: تقدير كمية التربة المتآكلة التي تصل فعلياً إلى المجاري المائية.
all_formulas.variables_ar:
A = مساحة مستجمع المياه
SDR = نسبة التوصيل

all_formulas.name: Buffer Strip Sediment Trapping Efficiency
all_formulas.variables:
k = trapping coefficient (0.05–0.15)
W = buffer width (m)
V = vegetation density factor (0.5–1.5)
all_formulas.purpose: Estimate % sediment trapped by vegetative buffer strip. Critical for riparian zone design + water quality protection.
all_formulas.example: 10 m grass buffer, dense (V=1.2), k=0.1: T = (1−exp(−0.1×10×1.2))×100 = (1−0.30)×100 = 70%. 70% of sediment trapped.
all_formulas.pitfall: Trapping decreases over time as buffer fills with sediment. Maintenance: scrape out every 5-10 yr.
all_formulas.decision: For 90% trapping: W = −ln(0.1)/(k×V). With k=0.1, V=1: W = 23 m buffer.
all_formulas.notes: Dosskey (2001). Also traps N (40-90%) + P (30-80%) + pesticides (50-95%).
all_formulas.purpose_ar: تقدير نسبة الرواسب المحتجزة بالحزام النباتي.
all_formulas.variables_ar:
k = معامل الاحتجاز
W = عرض الحزام
V = كثافة الغطاء

all_formulas.name: Contouring Factor (P) by Slope
all_formulas.variables:
P = support practice factor (0–1)
Slope = land gradient (%)
all_formulas.purpose: Determine erosion reduction from farming on contour (vs. up-down slope). Contouring cuts soil loss 10-50% on gentle slopes; little benefit on steep slopes.
all_formulas.example: 8% slope corn: P=0.6. Contouring reduces RUSLE A by 40%. From 2 t/ha to 1.2 t/ha.
all_formulas.pitfall: Contouring loses benefit if rows don't follow exact contour. Use GPS auto-steer with contour guidance.
all_formulas.decision: Combine contour + strip cropping on 3-8% slopes. Terraces needed on >8%.
all_formulas.notes: Foster (1988). RUSLE2 adds slope-shape + row-grade adjustments for more precision.
all_formulas.purpose_ar: تحديد تقليل التعرية من الزراعة على الكنتور.
all_formulas.variables_ar:
P = عامل الممارسة
Slope = الانحدار

all_formulas.name: Partial Budget (4-Box Method)
all_formulas.variables:
Added_revenue = new income from change
Reduced_costs = expenses eliminated
Added_costs = new expenses
Reduced_revenue = income lost
all_formulas.purpose: Evaluate financial impact of a practice change (new crop, equipment, technique). If net benefit > 0, change is profitable.
all_formulas.example: Switch to no-till: Reduced_costs = $80/ha (fuel, labor). Added_costs = $30/ha (herbicide). Reduced_revenue = $0 (same yield). Added_revenue = $0. Net = (0+80)−(30+0) = +$50/ha. Profitable.
all_formulas.pitfall: Partial budget assumes yield unchanged. If yield changes (often does), include in Added/Reduced revenue.
all_formulas.decision: If net > 0: implement. If <0: don't. If 0-10%: consider risk + non-economic factors.
all_formulas.notes: Cobia + Olson (2010). Most underused farm business tool — simple yet powerful.
all_formulas.purpose_ar: تقييم الأثر المالي لتغيير الممارسات الزراعية.
all_formulas.variables_ar:
Added_revenue = دخل إضافي
Reduced_costs = تكاليف ملغاة
Added_costs = تكاليف جديدة
Reduced_revenue = دخل مفقود

all_formulas.name: Net Present Value (NPV)
all_formulas.variables:
CF_t = cash flow in year t
r = discount rate (0.08 = 8%)
t = year (1 to N)
all_formulas.purpose: Evaluate capital investments (irrigation, machinery, greenhouse). NPV > 0 = profitable. Accounts for time value of money — $1 today worth more than $1 in 10 years.
all_formulas.example: Drip irrigation $3000/ha, 10-year life, $500/ha annual savings. r=8%. NPV = 500×[1−(1.08)^−10]/0.08 − 3000 = 500×6.71 − 3000 = +$355/ha. Profitable.
all_formulas.pitfall: NPV sensitive to discount rate. Use 8% for farm investments (USDA standard). Higher for risky investments.
all_formulas.decision: NPV > 0: invest. Compare competing investments by NPV (highest wins).
all_formulas.notes: Use real discount rate (subtract inflation). Use after-tax cash flows for final analysis.
all_formulas.purpose_ar: تقييم الاستثمارات الرأسمالية (الري، الآلات، البيوت المحمية).
all_formulas.variables_ar:
CF = التدفق النقدي
r = معدل الخصم
t = السنة

all_formulas.name: Internal Rate of Return (IRR)
all_formulas.formula:
IRR = r where NPV = 0
Solve: 0 = Σ (CF_t / (1+IRR)^t) − Initial
all_formulas.variables:
CF_t = cash flow in year t
IRR = discount rate where NPV=0
all_formulas.purpose: Calculate investment's rate of return. IRR > cost of capital (8%) = profitable. Easier to compare across investments than NPV.
all_formulas.example: Drip system example: IRR where 500×[1−(1+r)^−10]/r = 3000. Try r=10%: 500×6.14=3072. Close. r=10.5%: 500×5.94=2970. IRR ≈ 10.3%. Above 8% hurdle.
all_formulas.pitfall: IRR unreliable with non-conventional cash flows (negative then positive). Use NPV in those cases.
all_formulas.decision: IRR > hurdle rate (8-12%): invest. Compare: highest IRR project first.
all_formulas.notes: Excel: =IRR(range). Trial-and-error for hand calc. Modified IRR (MIRR) handles reinvestment assumption better.
all_formulas.purpose_ar: حساب معدل عائد الاستثمار.
all_formulas.variables_ar:
CF = التدفق النقدي
IRR = معدل العائد الداخلي

all_formulas.name: Payback Period
all_formulas.variables:
Initial = upfront cost
Annual_CF = net annual cash inflow
all_formulas.purpose: Years to recover investment. Simple, intuitive. Farmers prefer payback over NPV/IRR — 'how long until I get my money back?'
all_formulas.example: Drip system $3000/ha, $500/ha annual savings: Payback = 3000/500 = 6 years. Acceptable for 10-year system life.
all_formulas.pitfall: Ignores cash flows after payback. $500/yr for 4 yr vs. $1000/yr for 2 yr — same payback, very different NPV.
all_formulas.decision: Payback < 3 yr: low risk, do it. 3-5 yr: moderate. > 5 yr: high risk, need strong justification.
all_formulas.notes: Often used as screening tool: if payback too long, skip NPV/IRR analysis.
all_formulas.purpose_ar: سنوات استرداد الاستثمار.
all_formulas.variables_ar:
Initial = التكلفة الأولية
Annual_CF = التدفق السنوي

all_formulas.name: Sensitivity Analysis (Tornado Chart)
all_formulas.formula: ΔNPV = NPV(+10% input) − NPV(base case) and NPV(−10%) − NPV(base)
all_formulas.variables:
Input = yield, price, cost, discount rate
NPV = net present value
Range = max − min NPV across inputs
all_formulas.purpose: Identify which variables most affect profitability. Tornado chart ranks inputs by impact — top of chart = highest risk driver.
all_formulas.example: Drip system NPV=$355. Yield ±10%: NPV ±$200. Price ±10%: NPV ±$300. Cost ±10%: ±$80. Discount rate ±2%: ±$60. Top driver = price. Manage price risk first (forward contract).
all_formulas.pitfall: One-at-a-time sensitivity misses interaction effects (yield + price down together). Use Monte Carlo for full risk.
all_formulas.decision: Hedge top risk driver (forward contract, insurance). Tolerate low-impact risks.
all_formulas.notes: Palisade @Risk + Excel Solver do Monte Carlo. Spreadsheet-only: scenarios + data tables.
all_formulas.purpose_ar: تحديد المتغيرات الأكثر تأثيراً على الربحية.
all_formulas.variables_ar:
Input = متغير
NPV = صافي القيمة الحالية

all_formulas.name: Breakeven Yield
all_formulas.variables:
Total_cost = variable + fixed costs ($/ha)
Price = selling price ($/kg)
all_formulas.purpose: Calculate yield needed to cover all costs. Below breakeven = loss. Above = profit. Critical for new crop adoption decisions.
all_formulas.example: Maize: cost $1,200/ha, price $0.18/kg. Y = 1200/0.18 = 6,667 kg/ha = 6.7 t/ha. Below 6.7 t/ha: lose money. Above: profit.
all_formulas.pitfall: Breakeven ignores cash flow timing. With seasonal credit, may need Y_breakeven + 1-2 t/ha buffer for debt service.
all_formulas.decision: If expected yield < breakeven + 20% safety, don't plant. Try different crop.
all_formulas.notes: Variation: breakeven price = Total_cost / Expected_yield. Used for 'at what price do I profit?' decisions.
all_formulas.purpose_ar: حساب الإنتاجية اللازمة لتغطية جميع التكاليف.
all_formulas.variables_ar:
Total_cost = إجمالي التكاليف
Price = السعر

all_formulas.name: Machinery Ownership Cost ($/ha)
all_formulas.formula: Cost = (Depreciation + Interest + Insurance + Housing) / Annual_hours × ha/hr
all_formulas.variables:
Depreciation = (Purchase − Salvage) / Years
Interest = avg value × rate
Insurance + Housing = 1-2% of value
ha/hr = field capacity
all_formulas.purpose: Calculate true cost of owning equipment. Often 30-50% of total cost — hidden because no cash outlay. Critical for buy vs. custom hire decisions.
all_formulas.example: Tractor $80k, 10 yr, salvage $20k. Dep=$6k/yr. Interest (avg $50k × 6%)=$3k. Insurance+housing $1k. Total $10k/yr. Use 400 hr/yr → $25/hr. If custom hire $35/hr, own.
all_formulas.pitfall: Repair + maintenance adds 5-15% of value annually. Include fuel + labor separately (operating cost).
all_formulas.decision: If ownership cost > custom hire, custom hire. Don't own if < 200 hours/yr use.
all_formulas.notes: ASABE Standard EP496. Use 10-15% annual use rate for ownership cost; 30-40% for operating (fuel+labor+repair).
all_formulas.purpose_ar: حساب التكلفة الحقيقية لامتلاك المعدات.
all_formulas.variables_ar:
Depreciation = الإهلاك
Interest = الفائدة
Insurance = التأمين
ha/hr = السعة الميدانية

all_formulas.name: Operating Cost ($/ha)
all_formulas.variables:
Fuel = L/ha × $/L
Repair = accumulated repair %
Labor = $/hr × hr/ha
Opportunity = time × alternative wage
all_formulas.purpose: Calculate per-hectare operating cost for each field operation. Used for total production cost + profitability analysis.
all_formulas.example: Moldboard plow 25 ha/day, tractor 20 L/ha @ $1.20 = $24. Repair: $3/ha. Labor: $15/hr × 0.4 hr/ha = $6. Total $33/ha. No-till saves: 8 L/ha fuel + 0.1 hr/ha labor = $10/ha saved.
all_formulas.pitfall: Repair cost increases with age. Use accumulated repair curves (ASABE D497) for accuracy.
all_formulas.decision: Compare operations: no-till (1 pass, $15) vs. conventional (plow+disk+plant, $80). No-till cuts operating cost 60-80%.
all_formulas.notes: ASABE D497.7 (2020) machinery management data. Includes repair curves, fuel consumption, field efficiency for 100+ implements.
all_formulas.purpose_ar: حساب التكلفة التشغيلية لكل هكتار لكل عملية حقلية.
all_formulas.variables_ar:
Fuel = الوقود
Repair = الإصلاح
Labor = العمالة
Opportunity = البديل
